name: io.github.dynatrace-oss/dynatrace-managed-mcp
description: MCP server for Dynatrace Managed to access logs, events, and metrics.

environmentVariables.name: DT_MCP_RATE_LIMIT_MAX_CALLS
environmentVariables.description: Maximum number of tool calls allowed per rate limit window. Defaults to 20.

environmentVariables.name: DT_MCP_RATE_LIMIT_WINDOW_MS
environmentVariables.description: Rate limit window size in milliseconds. Defaults to 20000 (20 seconds).

environmentVariables.name: DT_CONFIG_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Path to a YAML or JSON file defining the Dynatrace Managed environment(s) to connect to. Recommended over DT_ENVIRONMENT_CONFIGS. Used if set, taking priority over DT_ENVIRONMENT_CONFIGS. One of DT_CONFIG_FILE or DT_ENVIRONMENT_CONFIGS must be set. See README file for contents of this.

environmentVariables.name: DT_ENVIRONMENT_CONFIGS
environmentVariables.description: An escaped JSON array that defines the Dynatrace Managed environment(s) to connect to. Used only if DT_CONFIG_FILE is not set. One of DT_CONFIG_FILE or DT_ENVIRONMENT_CONFIGS must be set. See README file for contents of this.

environmentVariables.name: DT_MCP_MAX_BODY_SIZE
environmentVariables.description: Maximum accepted HTTP request body size, in bytes. HTTP mode only. Larger requests receive a 413 error. Defaults to 1048576 (1 MiB).

environmentVariables.name: DT_MCP_TOKEN_VALIDATION_TTL_MS
environmentVariables.description: How long a validated API token is cached, in milliseconds. HTTP mode only. Set to 0 to disable caching. Defaults to 60000 (60 seconds).

environmentVariables.name: LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: Logging level (e.g. debug, info, warning, error)
